# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_BEARISH_ABOVE_15

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup currently lacks a VIX floor filter, allowing entries in low-VIX environments where premium is thin and moves fizzle, causing losses on marginal bearish days. Adding a VIX > 15 requirement will filter out low-quality bearish trades, preserving winners while reducing losers.

## Mechanism

In the bearish entry path (gates.py or filters.py), add a precondition: `if vix < 15: return False`. This will block any bearish setup trigger when VIX is below 15. No changes to bullish side or exit logic.
